description: [Requires sign-in] Set up scheduled monitoring for one or more store URLs (the 'set up monitoring' flow). Validates each URL and rejects invalid/private/internal ones. GUIDED FLOW: first ask the user for the URLs (paste a list or a CSV), then the frequency (daily/weekly/monthly, default weekly). Every monitor runs the core panel of personal shopping agents — no picking needed. Call once without confirmed=true to preview the exact setup and how many scans it will run, read that summary to the use

confirmed.description: Must be true only after the user has confirmed the summarized setup. If missing or false, ARC returns a preview and creates nothing.

depth.description: How far each scan goes. Default: cart.

frequency.description: How often to re-test. Default: weekly.

urls.description: Store/product URLs to monitor (a list or pasted CSV lines).

name: arcreport__bulk_create_monitors
